ops._comment: GOAL-122/123/124/125 (FAZ-12) operations UI translations: performance, security, backup, tenant export.

perf.title: Performance & Load Test
perf.subtitle: Critical scenarios p95/p99 latency, error rate and RPS metrics for pilot and first 100 tenant scale.
perf.k6_install: k6 binary required. Install with winget install k6 or from k6.io.
perf.threshold_override_help: Per profile and per scenario thresholds can be overridden via LOAD_TEST_<SCENARIO>_<PROFILE>_<METRIC> environment variables.
perf.warmup_cooldown_help: Warm-up/cool-down are emitted as k6 stages. JIT warm-up latency is excluded from threshold scoring.

security.title: Security Test & Severity Report
security.subtitle: OWASP ASVS L1-L3 control PASS/FAIL/SKIP summary for authentication, authorization, IDOR, XSS, CSRF, SQL injection, file upload, rate limit and tenant isolation.
security.remediation_help: Critical and high severity findings follow 24h / 7d SLA. Remediation commit should be linked to this report.

backup.title: Backup & Restore
backup.subtitle: PostgreSQL pg_dump + WAL streaming + object storage replication. RPO/RTO tiers: pilot 5min/1hr.
backup.encryption_help: Backup files encrypted at rest with AES-256 (SSE-S3 + Azure SSE). Client-side encryption is planned for FAZ-12+.
backup.retention_help: Retention policy: 7 daily, 4 weekly, 12 monthly. Older backups move to S3 Glacier.

tenant_export.title: Tenant Data Export
tenant_export.subtitle: Authorized tenant admins can securely export customer, patient, clinical, financial and file data. Runs async, produces audit trail.
tenant_export.retention_notice: Clinical records are retained for 7 years per KVKK Article 7. Export file is auto-deleted after 30 days.

onboarding.description: Let us help you get started. Pick your role and we will guide you through the first steps.
onboarding.step1_subtitle: Pick your role to personalise the guidance.
onboarding.step2_subtitle: Pick the closest match or describe your question.
onboarding.step2_input_placeholder: e.g. How do I record a vaccination?
onboarding.step3_subtitle: Follow the steps below. You can revisit this wizard from the help button.
onboarding.step3_no_match: No scenario matched your question. Try rephrasing or contact clinic staff.
onboarding.step3_medical_refusal: This assistant cannot help with medical questions (diagnosis, treatment, dosage). Please consult your veterinarian.
